policy: tick-start eligibility; simultaneous damage commit; no resurrection or within-tick cancellation
eligibility: Both attacker and target must be alive at this tick start. Commands from dead actors or aimed at dead targets produce no events.
enumeration: For each case: both actor insertion permutations times both command iteration permutations = 4 inputs; total 12.
comparison: Canonical HP by actor identity and canonical event records; actual emission order is not specified.
next_tick: Both-dead result at tick 8 has zero events with the same attack intentions.
naive_counterexample: For both-alive, process and mutate immediately in supplied command order. First attacker survives at 1, second dies at 0; one damage and one death event.
sorted_counterexample: Sort by attacker/action/target then immediately mutate. Always A survives; stable but violates chosen simultaneous policy.
scope: Original finite integer gameplay policy, not physics, engine integration, rollback or a universal combat rule. Unique command identities, only two actors and one attack per actor.
